title: From Network Intrusion Detection to Blockchain-Backed Endpoint Detection and Response: Mapping the Landscape of Decentralized Detection-and-Response Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.01872v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While the literature on blockchain-assisted intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) for Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks is mature, existing systematic reviews suffer from two critical limitations: they overlook the structural shift toward modern Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) architectures, and they conflate blockchain's distinct functional roles into a single monolithic category. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) addresses these gaps by proposing a three-axis taxonomy that classifies proposals by detection-system class (NIDS, HIDS, EDR/XDR), blockchain functional role, and response-automation maturity. translated_title: 从网络入侵检测到基于区块链的端点检测与响应：去中心化检测与响应架构的全景图谱
translated_abstract: 尽管关于区块链辅助的物联网和工业物联网网络入侵检测与防御系统的文献已经相当成熟，但现有的系统性综述存在两个关键局限：它们忽视了向现代端点检测与响应和扩展检测与响应架构的结构性转变，并且将区块链的不同功能角色混为一个单一的笼统类别。本知识系统化论文通过提出一个三轴分类法来填补这些空白，该分类法根据检测系统类别（NIDS、HIDS、EDR/XDR）、区块链功能角色以及响应自动化成熟度对各方案进行分类。通过综合2019年至2026年间发表于高影响力期刊和会议的研究成果，我们提供了严格的差距分析，揭示了由于延迟、去中心化等问题，真正基于每个端点的区块链锚定响应循环为何仍然几乎不存在。
tldr: 本论文提出一个涵盖检测系统类别、区块链功能角色和响应自动化成熟度的三轴分类法，系统梳理了区块链辅助入侵检测领域的研究版图，并揭示了基于端点的区块链锚定自动响应循环至今几乎缺失的根本原因。
en_tdlr: This SoK proposes a three-axis taxonomy classifying blockchain-assisted detection systems by detection-system class, blockchain functional role, and response-automation maturity, exposing why genuine per-endpoint blockchain-anchored response loops remain nearly nonexistent.
